props.caption: Zelenskyy said a Kyiv power plant and Kharkiv thermal power station No 5 were struck after Trump's ceasefire post.
King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, where an unknown projectile hit Passenger Hall 4 on Sunday.
Monday's missiles left the Pyongyang area for the East Sea; Japan put both splashes outside its EEZ.

items.note: Zelenskyy said TES No 5 in Kharkiv was hit after Trump's post. Moscow has not confirmed a halt.
Brent printed $103.35 by 00:37 GMT on Monday. Kyiv said Moscow struck power plants after the ceasefire declaration.
An unidentified projectile struck Passenger Hall 4 on Sunday, killing one Pakistani resident and wounding 11. Who fired remains disputed.
South Korea's Joint Chiefs detected Pyongyang-area launches at about 9:20 a.m. Japan counted two; the longer flew more than 910 km.
Delhi Metro closed six central stations from 6 am to 4 pm on Monday ahead of a called march. Interchange stayed available.
Zardari proclaimed emergency and governor's rule on Sunday. PTI said it would challenge in courts and assemblies.

lead.what: Nothing settled. The RBI oil-company dollar window stays open through 13 October; Québec's 64-seat table through 16:00 UTC on 12 October; the 16 October Russian-diesel waiver loading; Brazil's 25 October runoff; the December RBI repo hold; and the 22 October IEA leftover-stock withdrawal stay open.

Yes if Élections Québec posts a complete official National Assembly seat table awarding the Parti Québécois 64 or more of 127 seats by 16:00 UTC on 12 October 2026; no if that table awards 63 or fewer, or if no complete official seat table is posted by then. The prior is 0.28.

rest.what: Yes if a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 13 October 2026, that Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation and Bharat Petroleum Corporation met their 12 October dollar requirements through the Reserve Bank of India's special window and did not bid for those dollars in the onshore spot market; no if any of the three is reported bidding in that market for those requirements, or if no such report is posted by that deadline. The prior is 0.64.

Yes if a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 16 October 2026, that at least 300,000 tonnes of Russian diesel has been loaded onto tankers under the US Treasury energy-sector waiver announced on 9 October 2026; no if no such report is posted by that deadline. The prior is 0.42.

lead.what: Zelenskyy said Russia hit a Kyiv power plant and thermal power station No 5 in Kharkiv after Trump's energy-ceasefire post. Moscow has yet to comment.

rest.what: An unidentified projectile struck Passenger Hall 4 at King Khalid International on Sunday, killing one Pakistani resident and wounding 11. Authorities extended the airport closure until 2100 GMT on Monday.
President Zardari proclaimed emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on Sunday under Articles 232 and 234. PTI said it would challenge the order in courts, assemblies and public forums.
